z-m-15-05.title: Yeyiphi igrafu elungileyo ukubonisa idatha efanayo?
z-m-15-05.goal: Thelekisa indlela uhlobo ngalunye lwegrafu lubonisa ngayo ezinye izinto kakuhle nezinye kakubi, uze ukhethe igrafu ehambelana nenjongo, unika izizathu.
z-m-15-05.material:
Ithala leencwadi lesikolo lenze uphando ngenani leencwadi ezboleke inyanga nganye ukusuka kuMatshi ukuya kuAgasti.
Matshi 350, Epreli 380, Meyi 420, Juni 300, Julayi 410, Agasti 560 (isixa seenyanga ezi-6 yi-2420)
Sifuna ukubonisa le datha kwigrafu. Kwitshathi yepayi, asibhali inani leencwadi okanye isixa, kodwa kuphela ubukhulu beengxenye namagama eenyanga, kwaye iingxenye zibekwe ngolandelelwano ukusuka kwenkulu.
z-m-15-05.thinking.0: Ukuthelekisa nokuvavanya iindlela zokubonisa idatha ukuhambelana nenjongo
z-m-15-05.thinking.1: Ukwahlula oko igrafu ikubonisayo kwoko ikufihlayo
z-m-15-05.thinking.2: Ukuvuma ukuba ukhetho oluninzi lunokuba luvumelekile
z-m-15-05.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukufunda iigrafu zomgca neegrafu zemivalo (inqanaba lebanga 4)
z-m-15-05.prereq.1: Ukwazi ukuba igrafu yesangqa okanye igrafu yebhendi ibonisa umlinganiselo weengxenye kwisonke (inqanaba lebanga 6)
z-m-15-05.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukubonisa ngoko nangoko ukuba inani leencwadi ezibolekwe ukusuka kuMatshi ukuya kuAgasti litshintshe njani (ukuhamba kokunyuka nokuhla). Yeyiphi igrafu efanelekileyo ngakumbi?
z-m-15-05.s.s1.hint.0: Yitsho ngesivakalisi ukuba oko ufuna ukukubonisa 'zingaphi inyanga nganye' okanye 'litshintshe njani njengoko iinyanga zihamba.'
z-m-15-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga igrafu nganye engqondweni uthelekise ukuba utshintsho ukusuka kuMeyi ukuya kuJuni luyabonakala na.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.a: Le grafu ibonisa isabelo senyanga nganye kwisonke. Ayifanelekanga ukubonisa ukuhamba kokunyuka nokuhla njengoko iinyanga zihamba.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.b: Ilungele ukuthelekisa ubukhulu ngenyanga. Ukubonisa ukuhamba, igrafu yomgca inokuhambelana ngcono.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.c: Le grafu yahlula isonke sibe yimivalo enye ukubonisa izabelo. Kunzima ukubonisa icala lotshintsho kwiinyanga.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.r.d: Ukhumbule ukuba yigrafu ebonisa ubungakanani butshintsha ngexesha ngokunyuka nokuhla komgca.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.explain: Ukubonisa ukuba amaxabiso atshintsha njani njengoko ixesha lihamba, igrafu yomgca yeyona ingqo. Igrafu yemivalo nayo inokuthelekisa ngenyanga, kodwa igrafu yomgca ibonisa ngokucacileyo ngakumbi umgca onyuka uhla njengoko udibanisa.
z-m-15-05.s.s1.acc.0: Igrafu yemivalo nayo ilula ekuthelekiseni ngenyanga, kwaye ukunyuka nokuhla kunokufundwa kubude bemivalo. Noko, icala nobukhulu botshintsho zibonakala ngokucacileyo ngokujonga nje kwithambeka lomgca kwigrafu yomgca.
z-m-15-05.s.s2.prompt: Xa itsalwa njengetshathi yepayi (ngaphandle kwenani leencwadi okanye isixa, kuphela ubukhulu beengxenye namagama eenyanga, iingxenye zibekwe ukusuka kwenkulu), khetha yonke into onokuyixela ngoko nangoko ngegrafu yodwa.

z-m-15-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlela ukhetho ngalunye lube yimibuzo enokuphendulwa sisabelo nemibuzo efuna ulandelelwano okanye isixa sotshintsho.

z-m-15-05.s.s2.o.b: Ukubolekwa kwehle ngeencwadi ezingaphi phakathi kukaMeyi noJuni
z-m-15-05.s.s2.r.b: Iingxenye zibonisa kuphela isabelo, kwaye akukho nenani leencwadi okanye isixa esibhaliweyo. Awunakuxela ngegrafu yodwa ukuba yehle ngeencwadi ezingaphi.

z-m-15-05.s.s2.r.d: Iingxenye zibekwe ukusuka kwenkulu, ngoko awunakwazi ulandelelwano lweenyanga. Ukuba awazi ulandelelwano, kunzima nokwazi ukuhamba kokunyuka nokuhla.

Kodwa ekubeni inani leencwadi lingabhaliwe nolandelelwano lweenyanga alwaziwa, kunzima ukuxela ngetshathi yepayi yodwa ukuba yehle ngeencwadi ezingaphi okanye ingaba inyukile ngokuhamba kwexesha.
z-m-15-05.s.s3.prompt: Umhlobo ozobe igrafu yesangqa uthi, 'Ukujonga nje le grafu, ungabona ngokupheleleyo ukuhamba kokubolekwa kunyuka.' Bhala uluvo lwakho kumhlobo wakho, kubandakanya oko igrafu yesangqa ikubonisa kakuhle noko ikubonisa kakubi.

z-m-15-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba kukho umzekelo (njengesabelo se-Agasti) oxhasa uluvo lwakho?

z-m-15-05.s.s3.model.0: Igrafu yesangqa ibonisa kakuhle ipesenti ethathwa yinyanga nganye kwisonke. Umzekelo, i-Agasti yeyona ngxenye enkulu. Kodwa kunzima ukubona ukuhamba kokunyuka nokuhla njengoko iinyanga zihamba, ngoko ukubonisa ukuhamba, igrafu yomgca ingcono.

z-m-15-04.title: Ingaba ingxowa enamabhola abomvu amaninzi yeyona ilungileyo?
z-m-15-04.goal: Nquma ukuba ulwazi olunjani olufunekayo ukuthelekisa amathuba, uhlaziye uthelekiso xa ulwazi olutsha luvela, uze wenze umzekelo obonisa ukuba 'amaninzi' kunye 'nokuba nethuba elikhulu' akufani.
z-m-15-04.material: Kukho ingxowa 가 kunye ne-ngxowa 나. Uvala amehlo ukhuphe ibhola enye kwingxowa nganye. Amabhola ahluke kuphela ngombala; ubukhulu nemo yawo ziyafana. Ngumdlalo apho uphumelela ukuba ukhuphe ibhola ebomvu. Ukhupha ibhola kanye kuphela, kwaye awuyibuyiseli.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.prompt: Konke esikwaziyo ngoku kukuba 'ingxowa 가 inamabhola abomvu ama-3 kwaye ingxowa 나 inamabhola abomvu ama-5.' Yintoni efanelekileyo ngakumbi ukuyithetha malunga nokuba yeyiphi ingxowa enika ithuba eliphezulu lokuphumelela?

z-m-15-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nika umzekelo omnye wokuba ithuba litshintsha njani xa inani lamabhola eminye imibala litshintsha, nokuba inani lamabhola abomvu lifana.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.a: Ingxowa 나 iphezulu. Inamabhola abomvu ama-2 ngaphezulu.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.a: Uthelekise kuphela inani lamabhola abomvu. Asikakwazi ukwazi ukuba yinxalenye eyiphi yawo wonke amabhola abomvu.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.b: Ingxowa 가 iphezulu. Anciphe amabhola engxowa, kulula ngakumbi ukufumana ebomvu.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.b: Uthathe ukuba inani lamabhola lilonke lincinci, kodwa asinalo olo lwazi okwangoku. Luqikelelo olungenasiseko.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.c: Asikwazi ukuthelekisa ngaphandle kokwazi inani lamabhola lilonke (okanye inani lamabhola eminye imibala).
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.c: Ulatha ukuba ithuba limiselwa ngokujonga inani lamabhola abomvu nenani lamabhola lilonke kunye.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.o.d: Obomvu bayaphuma okanye abaphumi, ngoko amathuba amabini ayafana.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.r.d: Ugwebe amathuba ukuba ayafana ngenxa nje yokuba kukho iziphumo ezimbini. Inani leziphumo elifanayo alenzi amathuba afane.
z-m-15-04.s.s1.explain: Ithuba libalwa ngenxalenye ethathwa ngamabhola abomvu kuwo onke amabhola. Ukwazi kuphela inani lamabhola abomvu, asikwazi inani lamabhola lilonke, ngoko asinakuthi leliphi liphezulu. Kwimeko enje, kufanelekile ukuthi kuqala 'yintoni enye ekufuneka siyazi.'
z-m-15-04.s.s2.prompt: Kukho ulwazi olutsha. Ingxowa 가 inamabhola aziblowu ama-2 kwaye ingxowa 나 inamabhola aziblowu ama-4, kwaye akukho ngxowa inamabhola eminye imibala. Ngoku, kweyiphi ingxowa ithuba lokuphumelela liphezulu?

z-m-15-04.s.s2.o.b: Ingxowa 나 iphezulu. Inamabhola abomvu amaninzi, ama-5.
z-m-15-04.s.s2.r.b: Nangolwazi olutsha, uthelekise kuphela inani lamabhola abomvu. Jonga ukuba inani lamabhola lilonke litshintshile na.

Ukwenza umhluli ube yi-45 kunika i-27/45 kunye ne-25/45, ngoko ingxowa 가 iphezulu kancinci. Nangona ingxowa 나 inamabhola abomvu amaninzi, ithuba lokuphumelela liphezulu kwingxowa 가.
